venues.name: Amica Mutual Pavilion

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: General Information Number: (401) 331-0700 Box Office Number: (401) 331-6700 Group Sales: Contact Providence Sports + Entertainment at (401) 273-5000
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box Office Hours Monday through Friday 9am until 5pm Open weekends and evenings for events only.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, MC, Discover. American Express
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Pick-up tickets one hour prior to show at the "will call" window in the main lobby. Customers must present the actual credit card used to place the order, a photo i.d., and the order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Ample (2,300 spaces), safe (24 hour security patrolled), convenient (immediately adjacent to the Amica Mutual Pavilion), and professional (uniformed, trained personnel) parking available at the two Rhode Island Convention Center parking garages. Both garages are located immediately adjacent to the Amica Mutual Pavilion, one at 99 West Exchange Street (also adjacent to the Westin Hotel) and the other at 7 Service Road (directly across Service Road from the Amica Mutual Pavilion main entrance).
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This venue is equipped for accessible patrons.

generalInfo.generalRule: No cameras, video devices, or bottles are allowed per promoter requests.
generalInfo.childRule: Select performances offer discounts to children ages: 2-12 Exceptions may apply, please inquire.
